_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 0: the sound engine ($917C-$9B03). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): the tick (`$917C`, slot `$8009`, from the NMI)
regions.description: `$0307` (paused: `$97CC` raises it around a song start) non-zero returns at once.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): restart request
regions.description: `$0301` bit 0 is cleared; if it was set, **song 0 is loaded (`$97E4`) and every channel's state `$03E4` gets bit 6 (mute until its next note)**.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): clear the APU shadow
regions.description: `JSR $96A9`: the four channels' volume shadows := `$FF` (skip), `$0306` and `$0318` := 0.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): which channel is last
regions.description: **Channels 5 down to 0 run; channel 6 runs INSTEAD of 5 when `$0301` bit 1 or channel 6's own control (`$031F`) is non-zero**: Y := 5 (6 then), `$0302` := Y.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): next channel
regions.description: X := `$0302`; the channel's control `$0319,X` zero (idle) skips it (`$9239`).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): channel active: clear the note-start flag
regions.description: The state `$03E4,X` bit 7 (set at each note start) is cleared each tick.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): the note clock: software rate
regions.description: Flags `$0358` bit 0 (software-rate mode): the accumulator `$039E` += the step `$0397`; a carry steps the note clock (`$91E8`); otherwise `$91DD`.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): the note clock: countdown
regions.description: `$0374,X` (the countdown) is decremented; at 0 it is reloaded from the tick reload `$033C`, the position `$035F` += 1, and **reaching the length `$0366` ends the note and reads the stream (`$92F7`)**.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): the envelopes
regions.description: `JSR $95B2` (the volume envelope) and `JSR $964A` (the pitch envelope).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): the pitch slide
regions.description: Flags bit 7 (a slide is on): `JSR $92A7`.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): to the APU shadow
regions.description: `JSR $96BF`: the channel's output is written to its hardware channel's shadow.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): the volume fade
regions.description: Flags bit 5: the fade accumulator `$03C8` += the rate `$03C1`; on a carry the volume's low nibble `$0320` steps one toward the target `$03CF` (bit 1 of the flags is set on reaching it).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): next channel or end
regions.description: Channel 6 was the last: done; otherwise X - 1, `$0302` := X, back to `$91B6`.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): flush the shadow to the APU
regions.description: `$0306` (the busy mask of the four hardware channels) decides which channels are silenced (`$30` for the square channels' volumes, `$80` for the triangle's, written into the shadow `$0308/$030C/$0310/$0314`); then **`$0308-$0317` go to `$4000-$400F` (a `$FF` byte is skipped; the triangle's and noise's registers have special cases)**.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): a pitch slide (`$92A7`)
regions.description: The period (`$03B3`, `$03BA`) is changed by period >> the shift `$03D6`: added (up) or subtracted (down, flags bit 6) each tick; **a slide up stops at period high 8 and a slide down at 0, which zero the period**.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): read the stream (`$92F7`)
regions.description: The channel's stream pointer `$034A/$0351` into `$1C/$1D`, Y := 0.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): read a byte
regions.description: The byte at `($1C),Y`: bit 7 clear is a NOTE (`$94C8`).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command or repeat
regions.description: `$80-$AF` is a command; `$B0` and over repeats the previous note with a duration (`$94C2`).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): dispatch a command
regions.description: `ASL A / TAX`; the return address `$9302` (so `$9303` continues the stream) and the handler address - 1 from the table `$932C` are pushed; X := the channel; the first operand byte in A; `RTS` into the handler.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$80`: jump (`$9356`)
regions.description: The two operand bytes become the stream pointer (`$1C/$1D`), Y := `$FF`.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$81`: loop (`$9361`)
regions.description: Operand 0 plus the channel selects a counter field (`$0319 + n + c`); it is decremented and while non-zero the next two bytes are a jump.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): commands `$84` and `$82`: end (`$9370`, `$9376`)
regions.description: **`$84` first stores the channel's song number (`$03DD`) into `$0300` (the song-event register the title loop and the boss routine wait for); both zero the control `$0319,X` (the channel goes idle), drop four return addresses and go to `$9239`.**

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$83`: pitch envelope (`$9382`)
SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$85`: instrument (`$9386`)
regions.description: `$0327,X` := A (the volume envelope id).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$92`: volume (`$938A`)
regions.description: The low nibble of `$0320,X` := A.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$86`: transpose (`$9397`)
regions.description: `$0335,X` += A (0 sets nothing new: `BEQ`).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$88`: set a field (`$93A1`)
regions.description: Operand 0 + the channel selects a field; operand 1 is stored.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$8A`: the control byte (`$93AD`)
regions.description: **`$0319,X` := A: the channel's control field** (duty bits, bit 4 = envelope, bit 1 = also drive the noise channel). CORRECTION: `sound.py` and the first notes called this 'field `$0327`'; the instruction is `STA $0319,X`.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$87`: volume adjust (`$93B1`)
regions.description: A signed adjustment added to the low nibble of `$0320,X`, **clamped to 0-15**.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$94`: set a global flag (`$93DA`)
SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$8C`: volume fade (`$93E1`)
regions.description: **The fade target `$03CF` := A AND `$3F`**, flags bits 1, 4, 5 cleared, the accumulator `$03C8` := 0, the rate `$03C1` := the next operand; a non-zero rate sets flags bit 5 (the fade runs).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$8E`: conditional jump (`$9406`)
regions.description: If flags bit 1 (the fade has reached its target) is clear it jumps (`$9356`); else it skips the operand.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$8B`: transpose from a table (`$9414`)
regions.description: A pointer is built from operand 0 + (field 16 `$0389` - 1) and operand 1 (+ the carry); the byte there is added to the transpose `$0335,X`.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$8F`: software rate (`$9439`)
regions.description: `$0397` := A (the step) and the accumulator `$039E` := `$80`; flags bit 0 follows whether the step is non-zero: **the note clock then runs at a rate of its own instead of the frame tick.**

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$89`: detune (`$9457`)
regions.description: A signed value folded into the sequence / duty value `$03EB,X` (low nibble kept, bit 7 from the sign).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$8D`: pitch slide (`$9477`)
regions.description: A positive A sets the shift `$03D6` and flags bit 7, bit 6 clear (up); a negative A the same with bit 6 (down); 0 turns the slide off.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$90`: per-note sequence (`$949E`)
regions.description: The two operands are a POINTER into `$03F2/$03F9`; non-zero sets flags bit 3 (a sequence is running).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): command `$91`: hardware channel (`$94BE`)
regions.description: `$0343,X` := A: the hardware channel wanted (0 square 1, 1 square 2, 2 triangle, 3 noise).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): a repeat note (`$94C2`)
regions.description: The previous note `$036D,X` with a new duration.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): a note (`$94C8`)
regions.description: The note number is stored (`$036D`) and the pitch set (`$956F`); then the duration: a byte under `$E0` means the previous length (`$037B`); `$E0` takes the next byte; `$E1-$FF` index the duration table `$9941`.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): start the note
regions.description: Length `$0366` and `$037B` := the duration; the stream pointer advanced past what was read; the countdown reloaded from `$033C`; the position `$035F` and the pitch envelope position `$03AC` cleared; **the volume envelope position `$03A5` is cleared if the control's bit 4 is clear, or if it is set and the output volume is 0 (the envelope has run out)**; the state bit 7 (a note starts) is set.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): the note sequence step
regions.description: If flags bit 3: the byte from the sequence pointer (`$03F2/$03F9`): **a `00` byte is followed by a pointer that becomes the sequence pointer (a loop)**, any other byte is the duty and detune value (`$03EB`) - bits 5-6 give the duty, copied into the control's low bits.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): set the pitch (`$956F`)
regions.description: The note into `$03B3`; 0 clears the period high byte (silence). **Hardware channel 3 (the NOISE) uses the note directly: high byte 1, and a note of `$11` or more gets +`$70` (bit 7, the short-noise mode) before the transpose is subtracted.** Otherwise (note + transpose) x 2 indexes the period table at `$9840` and both bytes are stored (`$03B3`, `$03BA`).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): the volume envelope (`$95B2`)
regions.description: Control bit 4 and a non-zero instrument `$0327`: the envelope table `$99AB[2 id]` is stepped (`$9627`, position `$03A5`); the output volume = the channel volume + the envelope value - 15 (clamped), with the high nibble kept; otherwise the output is the channel's volume byte as it is.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): read an envelope byte (`$9627`)
regions.description: The byte at `($1E),Y`: a positive value is returned; **`$80` repeats the previous byte, `$81` goes back N bytes, `$82` restarts the table**.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): the pitch envelope (`$964A`)
regions.description: A non-zero period and a pitch envelope id `$032E` (bit 7 = none): the table `$995F[id]` is stepped (`$9627`) and the value added to the period (bit 6 chooses how the result is applied).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): silence the shadow (`$96A9`)
SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): output a channel (`$96BF`)
regions.description: `$0318` bit 5 (never set: dead) would mute. The control is ORed into `$0318`; **control bits 0-1 both clear: no output**. The hardware channel `$0343`: one already used this tick by another soft channel (`$9771` mask against `$0306`) is muted (state bit 6); otherwise its busy bit is set and: bit 1 of the control also drives the noise channel (`$9779`); bit 0 writes the channel's own shadow: volume `$0382`, `$032E`, period low `$03B3` and period high `$03BA` (with the instrument's high bits when the note has just started or the pitch envelope is off).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): the noise accompaniment (`$9779`)
regions.description: If the noise channel is free: its busy bit 3 is set, its volume `$0314` := the output volume, its period `$0316` := `$03EB` (the sequence value), and on a note start `$0317` := the instrument.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): init (`$97A0`, slot `$8000`)
regions.description: `$0301` and `$0307` := 0, then **`$97A8` (silence): the seven channels' controls cleared, the triangle linear counter 0, `$4015` := `$0F`, the three volume registers := `$30`**.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): play sound A (`$97CC`, slot `$8006`)
regions.description: `$0307`++ (the tick waits), A saved, X and Y saved, `JSR $97E4`, `$0307` := 0, registers restored.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): load a song (`$97E4`)
regions.description: `$0304` := the song number; `$9B04[2 n]` is the header pointer into `$1E/$1F`. **A first byte of 0 is not a header but CODE: the pointer + 1 is jumped to (`RTS` after pushing it) - the songs 31, 68, 69, 70 and 71.**

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): load a song: the tracks
regions.description: The header: [track count], then per track [channel][nine field bytes]: **a first field byte (the control) of 0 just silences that channel**; a control with bit 6 set stops the whole load (no header sets it, so this is dead); otherwise the song number goes into `$03DD,X`, the nine bytes into `$0319 + 7k + X` (fields 0-8), the flags `$0358`, state `$03E4`, position `$035F` and sequence value `$03EB` are cleared and the length `$0366` and countdown `$0374` := 1 (the stream is read on the next tick).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): song 70 (`$9933`)
regions.description: Header byte 0, then code: `$0301` := 3 (restart, channel 6 runs instead of 5).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): song 70, return
regions.description: `RTS`.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): song 71 (`$993A`)
regions.description: Code: `$0301` := 1 (restart) and the shared store.

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): songs 31 and 68 (`$993F`)
regions.description: Code: `JMP $97A8`: **silence everything** (the 'stop the music' sounds, e.g. `$1F`).

regions.name: SOUND ENGINE (bank 0 `$917C-$9B03`; channel c's field f at `$0319 + 7f + c`, see `ram.json`): song 69 (`$9AE0`)
regions.description: Code: the tick paused; for channels 4 down to 0: flags |= `$30` (a volume fade begins), the fade rate := `$0300`, the accumulator and target := 0 - **every channel fades to silence**; the tick resumed.
